def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frames = []
    frame_cells = set()
    for color in range(1, 10):
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not cells:
            continue
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
        r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
        c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1 - r0 < 2 or c1 - c0 < 2:
            continue
        border = {(r, c) for r in range(r0, r1 + 1) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)
                  if r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1)}
        if all(grid[r][c] == color for r, c in border):
            # A frame encloses an otherwise empty rectangle.
            if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(r0 + 1, r1)
                   for c in range(c0 + 1, c1)):
                frames.append((color, r0, r1, c0, c1))
                frame_cells |= border

    counts = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color and (r, c) not in frame_cells:
                counts[color] = counts.get(color, 0) + 1

    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r, c in frame_cells:
        out[r][c] = grid[r][c]
    for frame_color, r0, r1, c0, c1 in frames:
        checker_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(r0 + 1, r1) for c in range(c0 + 1, c1)
                         if (r - r0 - 1 + c - c0 - 1) % 2 == 0]
        fill_color = next((color for color, n in counts.items()
                           if n == len(checker_cells)), None)
        if fill_color is not None:
            for r, c in checker_cells:
                out[r][c] = fill_color
    return out
PY
